profile.headline: I am retired from Software Engineering.
profile.summary:
Results-driven individual contributor and technical leader of multinational teams delivering all phases of the Product Lifecycle. Adept at team building and delivering high quality products on time.

Individual contributions include: 
o	Software architecture, requirements creation, use case 
        development
o	Software development, product prototyping – Java (client 
        and server), C++, PHP, HTML, Flash 
o	6 papers published and 8 patents submitted on topics 
        ranging from Network Security, to XML and Java based 
        test tools.
